cards.title: I Meant to Teach That
cards.instruction: Treat any correction, surprise, or improvement as evidence your teaching succeeded. Claim each reversal as the lesson you intended all along.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A demonstration is more memorable than a warning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You ate three slices.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Commitment to the lesson. I'm glad you're questioning authority now.

cards.title: The Favor Not Yet Named
cards.instruction: Behave as though you hold decisive leverage, but delay naming it until another explanation has taken root.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then perhaps now is the moment for my receipt for its new roof.

cards.title: The Debt Changes Hands
cards.instruction: Treat every favor as shifting who owes whom. Recalculate the balance whenever help is accepted, refused, or remembered.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now you're saving me work. The debt has increased.

cards.title: The Debt Changes Hands
cards.instruction: Treat every favor as shifting who owes whom. Recalculate the balance whenever help is accepted, refused, or remembered.

Retained the neighbor, parcel, rain and rubbish setting; replaced wet cardboard with a leaking bag whose cleanup creates the final repayment. FirstPass remains the exact original assessment. Separate internal coach-1.0 reread: fidelity 5, because A1, A3 and A5 revise the creditor and balance; logic 5, because B2 establishes a second favor for A3 and B4 explicitly clears both before A5 adds the leak premium; relationship 4, because B4 accepts useful help and proposes a settlement A can dispute; heightening 4, because A5 turns B4's settlement into a fresh obligation for B; specificity 5, because A1's upstairs parcel and B4's three flights make the chore concrete; brevity 4, because A5's cleaning request follows directly from the leaking bag without a separate joke. cards.title: We Keep Switching Places
cards.instruction: Return to a familiar relationship pattern, then reverse who performs each role whenever the scene reaches similar pressure.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You fix the leaking tap this time. I'll stand here saying it'll flood.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It might. I can't find the valve.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine, give me the spanner. You're better at worrying.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Actually, turning this stopped it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. I'll return to wondering whether it'll start again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The tap's leaking again. Give me the spanner before you start pricing lifeboats.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've found the valve. You look terrified.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you fix it. I'll keep the towels ready for when the kitchen goes under.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The valve's stuck. What if I snap it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me the spanner. You take the towels; you've reached the sinking-kitchen stage.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 swaps fixer and worrier after B2, but A5 swaps back after B4 resolves the leak rather than at renewed similar pressure.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's missing valve motivates A3's intervention and B4's success motivates A5's withdrawal, though pressure no longer matches.

relationship.evidence: B2 needs practical help and B4 finds a solution, but A1 mostly announces the relationship roles.

heightening.evidence: A5 resumes worrying after B4 stops the water, without a new consequence or comparably urgent problem.

cards.title: We Keep Switching Places
cards.instruction: Return to a familiar relationship pattern, then reverse who performs each role whenever the scene reaches similar pressure.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Today you reassure me about the presentation. I'm usually the calm one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. It'll be brilliant. Unless the projector fails.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll check the projector. You breathe.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's working. See? Nothing to worry about.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let me worry about the audience while you stay impressively calm.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The projector's dead. Usually I talk you down, but today I need you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can use my laptop. Nobody's going to die.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep saying that while I imagine twelve directors sharing one screen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My laptop's dead too. We're finished.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nobody's going to die. I'll print twelve copies; you sit down before we need thirteen.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 names the usual calm role and A3 reverses the current roles; A5's second reversal follows reassurance rather than renewed equipment pressure.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's projector fear, but A5 introduces the audience after B4 says the projector works.

relationship.evidence: B2 tries to reassure and exposes anxiety; B4 recovers enough confidence to reassure A again.

heightening.evidence: A5 moves to audience worry after B4 but mostly requests the same reassurance as A1.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a presentation and B2 identifies the projector as a concrete source of worry.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'You breathe' quickly reverses the dynamic; A5 is concise but more descriptive than consequential.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 explicitly reverses the usual calming role, while A5 resumes it when B4 reaches the same equipment-failure panic.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 imagines B2's laptop solution serving twelve directors; A5 replaces B4's failed laptop with printed copies.

specificity.evidence: A1's dead projector, A3's twelve directors and A5's twelve copies clearly establish the meeting emergency.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 offers a laptop and reassurance; A3 asks for continued reassurance while exposing the laptop's audience-size problem.

hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A starts as the unusual recipient of reassurance and becomes the familiar reassuring fixer when B collapses.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 restores the usual roles only after both display options have failed.

cards.title: Become What You Compete With
cards.instruction: Turn comparison into imitation: adopt whatever quality seems powerful, allowing each borrowed trait to change the basis of the rivalry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your cake won because it was minimalist. I'm removing half my decorations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yesterday you called mine bare.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before restraint became our competitive frontier.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're copying me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Improving. I've now removed the cake stand too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your cake won because it was minimalist. I'm removing half my decorations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I won for giving everyone a slice. Yours stayed behind glass.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll serve pieces twice your size. Pass me the knife.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's a queue of twenty. I cut mine small so nobody missed out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then mine will be thinner. I'll feed the queue and the people they go home to.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 adopts the winning cake's minimalism, A3 makes restraint the competitive criterion, and A5 tries to exceed B on that criterion.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 reinterprets B2's reminder of criticism; A5 answers B4's copying accusation by claiming a further subtraction.

relationship.evidence: B2 remembers A's disparagement and B4 wants the imitation acknowledged.

heightening.evidence: B4's challenge prompts A5 to extend restraint beyond decorations to the cake stand itself.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a cake competition and visible decorations; A5 offers a playable additional removal.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's competitive frontier is inflated but purposeful, and A5's cake-stand subtraction follows that exact criterion.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 copies perceived minimalism, A3 copies sharing as larger portions, and A5 copies inclusive distribution as thinner portions; each borrowed quality changes the rivalry.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 replaces decoration with sharing as the winning quality, causing A3 to serve cake. B4 explains the twenty-person queue, causing A5 to reverse portion size.

relationship.evidence: B2 challenges A's glass-protected cake, and B4 wants everyone in the queue served. B has a practical concern beyond supplying competitive prompts.

heightening.evidence: B4's concern that nobody miss out prompts A5 to expand the imagined beneficiaries from twenty people to their households.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes rival cakes and removable decorations; B2's glass display, A3's knife and B4's queue provide concrete choices actors can play.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'twice your size' and A5's 'thinner' make the competitive reversal economical; the household promise follows A's escalating imitation.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 identifies sharing as the source of success; A3 abandons merely removing decorations and offers competitively generous slices.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 explains that small slices allowed twenty people to eat; A5 adopts thin slicing to compete on the number fed.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A repeatedly imitates B's newly identified strength while attempting to exceed it, changing the contest from appearance to generosity to reach.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 retains the same cake-sharing rivalry and expands its ambition to people beyond the actual queue.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A imitates each newly perceived source of B's success, moving the rivalry from visual restraint to generous portions and then to how many people can be included.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Single-axis one-upmanship would keep subtracting decorations; A instead reverses the portion strategy when B reveals that inclusion made small servings powerful.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A1 borrows minimalism, A3 borrows B2's sharing as larger portions, and A5 abandons that size contest for B4's small-slice inclusion.

records.recommendedEdit: Replaced the rejected original's continued subtraction with successive changes in the perceived winning quality. Kept the cake competition and added a serving queue and A's glass display as illustrative circumstances. FirstPass is preserved exactly. Separate internal coach-1.0 reread: fidelity 5, because A1, A3 and A5 imitate success on changing terms; logic 5, because B2's sharing causes A3's large portions and B4's queue and small slices cause A5's thinner portions; relationship 4, because B2 corrects A's explanation and B4 protects the waiting guests' access; heightening 4, because A5 extends B4's inclusion goal to guests' households; specificity 5, because A1 establishes the cakes and B4 supplies twenty waiting people; brevity 4, because A5's thinner slices visibly reverse A3's boast without explaining the card. Total 92. Five spoken ABABA turns, under 75 words, and all hard gates pass on internal reread.

cards.title: Become What You Compete With

cards.title: The Incident Keeps Changing
cards.instruction: Carry an unnamed past rupture whose meaning shifts with each new detail, while never letting its emotional weight diminish.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I still haven't forgiven you for missing my concert.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was outside. They wouldn't let me in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you were close enough to hear and still didn't call?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I heard you dedicate a song to me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So you knew exactly how abandoned I felt, in perfect acoustics.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can give you another concert ticket. That doesn't mean we're past that evening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was outside the door the whole time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So it wasn't distance. You were that close and left me alone with it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I heard you say my name. I thought you wanted me to stay out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then what I carried as silence was you listening. I don't know how to hand you this ticket now.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 explicitly names missing the concert as the rupture, contradicting the unnamed requirement despite A3 and A5 preserving its weight.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's proximity and A5 uses B4's heard dedication, though perfect acoustics overstates what B established.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers exclusion as an exculpatory detail and B4 reveals having heard a personally meaningful dedication.

heightening.evidence: B4's evidence of attention becomes A5's stronger charge that B understood the abandonment.

specificity.evidence: A1's concert, B2's barred entrance and B4's dedication create a coherent shared event.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's acoustics phrase draws on B4's hearing, but adds polish at the expense of emotional plainness.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 leaves the rupture unnamed; A3 changes absence into nearby abandonment, and A5 changes silence into listening without easing the hurt.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's position outside the door drives A3's proximity accusation; B4's hearing A's name drives A5's reinterpretation of silence.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 disclose proximity and a misunderstood cue, giving B a perspective beyond simple denial.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes the new understanding interfere with the ticket A1 was prepared to offer, increasing the present consequence.

specificity.evidence: A1's concert ticket and B2's door ground the unnamed incident, though the reason B4 heard exclusion remains deliberately uncertain.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'that close' and A5's difficulty handing over the ticket concentrate emotional change without unrelated comic decoration.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 reveals physical closeness; A3 revises the wound from distance to abandonment despite proximity.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 reveals active listening and a mistaken interpretation; A5 revises the meaning of B's silence and hesitates over the ticket.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: Each detail changes the interpretation of one unnamed rupture while preserving its emotional weight.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 carries the revised past into the current decision to include B again.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A maintains the full emotional burden of an unnamed rupture while each new detail changes whether it means absence, chosen distance or listening without joining.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: A fixed grievance would use every detail to repeat one accusation; A changes the understood nature of the injury without resolving it.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Revised A1 leaves 'that evening' unnamed, A3 reinterprets B2's proximity, and A5 changes silence into listening because of B4.

records.recommendedEdit: Removed the named rupture while retaining a concert context and adding a present ticket offer. Separate internal coach-1.0 reread: fidelity 5, logic 5, relationship 4, heightening 4, specificity 4, brevity 4 = 90. B4's hearing and mistaken interpretation cause A5 to reconsider the present offer without reducing the hurt. All gates pass.
records.remainingConcern: B4's interpretation of hearing a name is underexplained, and A5 uses literary phrasing. The scene still supplies a coherent emotional action. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: The exact injury stays deliberately unresolved, so performers must play the clear ticket negotiation without supplying a definitive account of that evening.
records.alternativeComparison: This version makes renewed inclusion harder; the letter alternative turns painful reinterpretation into a request for B to remain present.

cards.title: Every Compliment Raises the Bar
cards.instruction: Treat each compliment as sincere admiration and a new standard you must immediately surpass.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One tier was already impressive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Was. We've established that as the baseline.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You don't have to prove anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll add a third tier so that becomes convincingly true.

beats.text: You called my cake impressive. I'll add a second tier before you leave.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: B

beats.text: Gladly. If simple is my standard, I'll get the whole budget onto your napkin before the sandwiches arrive.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 and A3 accept praise as a higher standard, but A5 declines a break without specifying an immediate further improvement.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 directly uses B2's excellent rating; A5 answers B4's break offer by referring back to the two earlier compliments.

relationship.evidence: B2 affirms A's success and B4 offers rest, giving B a credible caring position.

heightening.evidence: A5 restates the raised-standard problem after B4 rather than developing A1's proposed agenda rewrite.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes meeting performance and an agenda, but A3 does not explain what would surpass excellence.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's counted compliments make an efficient response, although the final turn summarizes more than acts.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 responds to praise with agenda improvement, A3 raises the summary standard, and A5 turns simplicity praise into a napkin-sized budget challenge.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's excellent summary causes A3's shorter, clearer version; B4's budget request over lunch determines A5's format and deadline.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants A to join lunch, and B4 finds a useful request that channels A's improvement drive into companionship.

heightening.evidence: A5 commits to the whole budget on one napkin before food arrives, increasing compression and urgency after B4's request.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes meeting preparation and B2 sandwiches; A5 supplies a playable napkin task, although the budget's contents remain unspecified.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's napkin and sandwich deadline earn the comic ambition from B4's lunch request, though 'If simple is my standard' explains the mechanism.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 praises the summary; A3 immediately commits to making the next one shorter and clearer.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 praises simplicity and requests a budget explanation at lunch; A5 exceeds that standard through napkin compression and a food-arrival deadline.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A accepts admiration warmly but treats each compliment as a minimum to surpass immediately.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: B's helpful lunch solution becomes a fresh, stricter expression of A's improvement compulsion.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A accepts a colleague's praise as a binding new performance standard and immediately redesigns the next task to surpass it.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: General overwork could continue regardless of feedback; each specific compliment here determines the form of the extra work.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Revised B2's excellent summary prompts A3's shorter, clearer version, and B4's praise of simplicity prompts A5's whole-budget napkin target.

records.recommendedEdit: Kept the workplace setting and gave B a shared lunch and real budget question. Separate internal coach-1.0 reread: fidelity 5, logic 5, relationship 5, heightening 4, specificity 5, brevity 4 = 95. B4 provides admiration, a task and a setting, all used by A5's immediate self-imposed target. All hard gates pass.
records.remainingConcern: A5 explains its standard-setting rationale more than necessary, but the helpful interaction and concrete constraint sustain it. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: A's napkin target measures compression rather than proven clarity; whether it helps B remains a playable question.
records.alternativeComparison: B successfully redirects the behavior into shared lunch and useful explanation; the cake guest's attempts to leave generate additional decoration.
